Interface BlockingSubscription<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the type of values delivered by this subscription
All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable, Subscription
All Known Implementing Classes:
DefaultBlockingSubscription
public interface BlockingSubscription<T> extends Subscription, AutoCloseable
A pull-based Subscription where the caller explicitly polls for values by calling next(Duration). Each call blocks until a value is available, the timeout elapses, or a terminal condition is reached.

After next(Duration) returns a terminal result (NextResult.Completed, NextResult.Expired, NextResult.Deleted, or NextResult.Errored), Subscription.isActive() will return false and all subsequent calls to next() will return the same terminal result.

If the calling thread is interrupted while blocked in next(), the subscription becomes inactive and the thread's interrupt flag is restored.

BlockingSubscription extends AutoCloseable so it can be used with try-with-resources. The close() default implementation simply delegates to Subscription.cancel().

  • Method Details

    • next

      NextResult<T> next(Duration timeout)
      Blocks until the next result is available or the given timeout elapses.

      Possible outcomes:

      • NextResult.Value — a new value was delivered.
      • NextResult.Timeout — the timeout elapsed with no value available; the subscription is still active.
      • NextResult.Completed — the underlying primitive completed naturally.
      • NextResult.Expired — the underlying primitive's TTL elapsed.
      • NextResult.Deleted — the underlying primitive was explicitly deleted.
      • NextResult.Errored — an unexpected error occurred.
      Parameters:
      timeout - the maximum time to wait for a result
      Returns:
      a NextResult describing the outcome

    • close

      default void close()

      Equivalent to calling Subscription.cancel(). Provided so that BlockingSubscription instances can be used with try-with-resources blocks. Does not throw.

      Specified by:
      close in interface AutoCloseable
